q: Read a file of numbers, one per line, and print their total.
code:
open("n.txt", "w").write("10\n20\n30\n")

    for line in f:
        total = total + int(line.strip())
print(total)

Make a list of four Employee objects and print the one with the highest salary.
code:
class Employee:
    def __init__(self, name, salary):
        self.name, self.salary = name, salary

staff = [Employee("Rahul", 47764), Employee("Priya", 62990),
         Employee("Amit", 51200), Employee("Kavya", 58300)]

top = max(staff, key=lambda e: e.salary)
print(top.name, top.salary)

q: From a list of Employee objects, print the average salary of the Tech department only.
code:
class Employee:
    def __init__(self, name, dept, salary):
        self.name, self.dept, self.salary = name, dept, salary

staff = [Employee("Rahul", "HR", 47764), Employee("Priya", "Tech", 62990),
         Employee("Amit", "Tech", 51200)]

tech = [e.salary for e in staff if e.dept == "Tech"]
print(sum(tech) / len(tech))
